scope_and_boundary.description: Narrow implementation prerequisite extracted from OSS-RESEARCH-BASELINE-001 delivering independent MLflow 3.16.1 and QuantLib 1.43 compatibility.
scope_and_boundary.boundary_safeguards: Zero modifications to six-framework adapters (DSPy, TRL, FinRL, RLlib, Qlib) or compose profiles. No production data migration, credential changes, or real-capital operations.

wheel_identities_and_sources.primary_release_channel: PyPI release manifests and official wheels

quantlib_numerical_consolidation.american_pricing: ql.BinomialVanillaEngine(process, 'crr', steps=steps) with continuous research contracts and dividend yield support
quantlib_numerical_consolidation.evaluation_date_preservation: All evaluationDate overrides are wrapped in try...finally blocks to restore settings.evaluationDate on return or error, avoiding global singleton mutation and moving curve corruption.
deduplication: services/research/quantlib/adapter.py: consolidated price_european and price_american_binomial onto QuantLib
services/research/quantlib/production_option_chain.py: removed duplicate analytical BSM formula, delegated to price_european
services/research/quantlib/adapter/quantlib_adapter.py: _bs_metrics and american_binomial_metrics delegate directly to core adapter
quantlib_numerical_consolidation.reference_fixtures: Analytical BSM formulas and CRR tree reference formulas retained strictly in services/research/quantlib/test_adapter.py as frozen comparison fixtures with tolerances: price/delta/gamma 1e-4, vega/theta 1e-3. 6 regression tests verify dividend yields, early exercise premiums, interest rate sensitivities, short maturities/boundary values, calendar conventions, and evaluationDate preservation.
quantlib_numerical_consolidation.consumer_import_compatibility: Preserved read-only consumer imports (GovernedMarketSnapshot DTOs, registry admission packet validation, and persona oss_runtime) by deferring QuantLib import to actual numerical execution within services/research/quantlib/adapter.py. Added subprocess regression suite TestConsumerImportsWithoutQuantLib in services/research/quantlib/test_adapter.py proving imports succeed without QuantLib installed while maintaining full numerical verification.

mlflow_security_and_runtime_verification.tracking_and_artifact_roundtrip: Verified in test_sqlite_tracking_and_artifact_roundtrip using isolated temporary SQLite store and local artifact repository.
mlflow_security_and_runtime_verification.basic_auth_boundary: Verified in test_basic_auth_boundary_rejection_and_admission: unauthenticated access receives 401, invalid credentials receive 401, valid admin credentials receive 200 on /api/2.0/mlflow/users/get via REST API probe.

container_verification.verification_command: docker run --rm pantheon-test-registry-experiments:latest python -c 'import mlflow, wandb, numpy; from adapter import MLFLOW_VERSION_PIN; print(mlflow.__version__, wandb.__version__, numpy.__version__, MLFLOW_VERSION_PIN); assert mlflow.__version__ == "3.16.1" == MLFLOW_VERSION_PIN; assert numpy.__version__ == "1.26.4"'

docker run --rm --entrypoint python pantheon-test-research-mlflow:latest -c 'import mlflow, flask_wtf, pydantic, redis, numpy; print(f"mlflow: {mlflow.__version__}, flask_wtf: {flask_wtf.__version__}, pydantic: {pydantic.__version__}, redis: {redis.__version__}, numpy: {numpy.__version__}"); assert mlflow.__version__ == "3.16.1"; assert redis.__version__ == "5.2.1"; assert numpy.__version__ == "1.26.4"'
